status: proposed explicit print allowlist; exact internal inventory unchanged
scope: Conventional dictionary presentation requested by user; this is selective print access, not the full inflection inventory.
generation_findings: The old first-two-folded-letters heuristic misses changed stems behind prefixes and expands whole ordinary ending families.
The old existing-heading suppression hides additional genuine homographs, notably bętst as an adverb of wel.
Keep all 5,580 exact accepted surface records internally; removing printed form lists or crossrefs must not remove data routes.
print_rules: Infinitive/citation entry carries selected principal parts and grammar notes. A crossref is a labelled pointer, not a second paradigm.
Include selected vowel-changing or contracted present 3sg forms, including prefixed verbs and exact evidenced variants.
Include representative suppletive, irregular weak and preterite-present stems; avoid the remaining ending-by-ending families.
Ordinary strong preterites remain recoverable through principal parts; only markedly opaque contractions or suppletion receive additional pointers.
Preserve frequent opaque pronoun/demonstrative forms, selected root/kinship noun forms, irregular numeral forms, degree forms and meaningful lexical variants.
Do not print ordinary weak dental-past/participle families, routine endings, full participial declensions, or every spelling produced by mark folding.
Never strip ge- mechanically. Resolve the exact surface through the accepted entry route.
When a selected spelling is also a lexical head, retain that lexical entry and append the additional labelled pointer; do not silently suppress either route.
Existing independent adjective comparative/superlative entries remain lexical entries. Give them positive-head links instead of duplicate crossref-only records.
Where the citation is not established, retain the bounded supplied-form head and its note; do not invent an infinitive.
